ourKits.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
ourKits.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
ourKits.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
ourKits.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Throw Alacrity for a shield and speed, place Consecrated Ground for ally attack speed and healing, fully charge Serenity for a stun, and use Reversal of Fortune to fly to an ally anywhere and knock up enemies on arrival.
ourKits.winCondition: Keep the carry alive with shields and Reversal of Fortune saves while Sentinel cuts enemy healing.
ourKits.passive: Sentinel: her damaging abilities cut enemy healing and her abilities boost allies' healing and shielding received.
ourKits.playWith: A hyper-carry she can shield and a team that can follow her global ult into a fight.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the charging Serenity bolt and step out of its line before it reaches max charge. When Reversal of Fortune is down she cannot join distant fights, so pick off her side lanes then.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
enemyKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
enemyKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

enemyKits.combo: Ascend to dive onto the backline, Chastise to slow and reset her basic attack, Heaven's Fury to go untargetable and strike, then Heresy for speed, attack speed and true-damage burns.
enemyKits.winCondition: Dive the backline, get the first takedown and chain free Heresy activations from Fallen Grace.
enemyKits.passive: Fallen Grace: hero takedowns drop a visage that, when touched, activates Heresy for free and cuts her basic ability cooldowns.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that creates her dive angle and CC that holds targets for her.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not waste CC or burst during Heaven's Fury, since she is invulnerable then; hit her as she lands from Ascend. Deny the first kill so she cannot pick up the visage.

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip dashes in, Eventide and Blade Siphon hit to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast suppresses the Haemorrhaged target for bonus damage and full healing, with Shadow Slip recast to swap back out
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast a Haemorrhaged squishy for bonus damage, heal it back, and escape through the Shadow swap
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with two abilities within a short window applies Haemorrhage, a max-health true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her engage, so peel or punish after it is spent; note where her Shadow was left, since she can swap back to it; magic armor and anti-heal blunt her Blade Siphon and Feast healing

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
enemyKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
enemyKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

loadout.name: Volcaic Slam
loadout.text: Empowered Cindara leaves behind a rupture that erupts after 0.5s. The eruption deals 20 (+4 per Level) (+25%) Damage to Enemies and Slows by 40% for 1.25s.
loadout.plain: When an outer-edge Ashen Vow hit empowers your next Cindara, that lantern slam also leaves a rupture that erupts and slows. It gives your Ashen Vow into Cindara combo a second hit and makes it hard to walk out of.

loadout.name: Knell
loadout.text: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.
loadout.plain: Every Cindara swing and ability on a hero adds Rust, cutting their armor and adding some to yours. Your fast stab and slam combos hit max Rust quickly, so longer trades against bruisers and tanks swing your way.

loadout.name: Patina
loadout.text: Gain a 30 (+14 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 10s. Gain 4% Movement Speed while the shield holds.
loadout.plain: A small shield and some move speed come back after you go untouched for 10s. Mostly a lane and roaming comfort piece; it softens the first poke before you dash in with First Intent.

loadout.name: Fracture
loadout.text: Deal 4% (+0.2% per level) more damage against targets with maximum stacks of Rust.
loadout.plain: Extra damage on anyone carrying max Rust from Knell. Since Scarlett chains stabs, slams and Cindara swings, she reaches max stacks fast, so this is a steady bonus through every extended trade.

loadout.name: Judgement
loadout.text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: An area hit around you that heals you when it lands on heroes. Fire it in the middle of an Ashen Vow spin or right after Swan Song lands you in a group, for burst plus a heal.

bullets: Thraex briefly marked the last enemy hero hit by a rifle shot: Legion dealt more damage to that hero and took less damage from that marked hero only.
The King paid gold for each basic attack on heroes; Rallying Roar shortened Orbital Sanction's cooldown, and casting Orbital Sanction sped Legion and nearby allies, on a cooldown.
Nuclear Rounds raised ability damage from critical chance, boosting Frag Order, Saturation Charge and Orbital Sanction; Nuclear Rounds' 20 haste brought Orbital Sanction back about 17% sooner.
Natural Resistance cleansed crowd control and added heavy tenacity when Phase dropped low, with the cleanse on a cooldown, so Phase could still Blink or cast to escape.
Weald fired true-damage missiles at low-health enemy heroes Phase hit, on a per-hero cooldown; Barkskin struck heroes basic attacking Phase, firing Prophecy at reduced strength.
Prophecy added damage to every basic attack and Storm Breaker built stacks from moving and attacking, so Hyperflux's attack and movement speed on Phase sped up both items.
Attacks and abilities on enemy heroes stacked Knell's Rust, shredding armor and giving Scarlett part of the shredded armor; Fracture added damage against targets at maximum Rust stacks.
Patina shielded Scarlett after a stretch without taking damage, with movement speed while the shield held, so fights started shielded before First Intent added a second shield.
Tainted Blade cut target healing on physical damage, and Infernum's Kindling from abilities and attacks ignited targets at 4 stacks for max-health damage alongside Mutilator's hits.
